' "$PRE"; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100 >/dev/null; echo dial_requested=true; ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 40); do S=$(state); echo live_call_state=$S; if [ "$S" = "2" ]; then ACTIVE=1; break; fi; sleep 1; done; test "$ACTIVE" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; ACTIVE_AUDIO=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO"; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; echo silent_audio_guard_active=true; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; START=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.DiagnosticProbeActivity --ez run_shizuku_live_probe true 2>&1); printf '%s
' "$START"; printf '%s
' "$START" | grep -q 'Status: ok'; sleep 9; LOG=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S'); printf '%s
' "$LOG"; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'shizuku_live_probe_start=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'probe=shizuku-user-service-live-v1'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'service_uid=2000'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'active_after_start=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'heartbeat_after_start=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'media_ok_before_endpoint_close=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'prepared_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'active_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'heartbeat_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'privileged_uid=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'live_parity_ok=true'; cleanup; trap - EXIT; test "$(state)" = "0"; echo phase2_m3_live_parity_silent_green=true
